main_text.head: CAPUT XIIII. DE LAPIDIBUS.
main_text.p: De Lapi-dibus.Xplicatis metallis, sequuntur Lapides, qui sunt regulares, vel anomali.

Lapis regularis.Regulares sunt corpora inanimata fos-silia dura, ex sicca terrestri exhalatione, unctuositate quadam aquosa permixta, per temporis diuturnitatem vi caloris & frigoris, virtuteq; minerali coglutinata.

p.i: Vis mineralis hic dicitur vis, quæ cælitus data est loco & materiæ ad formandum hunc vel illum lapidem: Sic ut vis mineralis dicatur vis formatrix latens in semine.
Nascuntur lapides sub terra, vel in caver-nis terræ, in locis montosis, in ripis quarundam aquarum.
Terra non mollis sed solida superfi-ciei, ex qua vapor expirare non potest, multos lapides producit: Ripæ fluminum sempiterno-rum sunt solidissima, claudentes in se vapores.

main_text.p: Vulgares ex crassiore & impuriore materia concrescunt.

page.notes: The woodcut initial X of "Xplicatis" is joined to its word. Two left-margin notes: "De Lapidibus." and "Lapis regularis." Doubtful: "femine" read as "semine" (long s, the scan is faint there); "solidissima" at the line overlap with the comma after it is partly obscured and may read differently. The line "Lapides sunt vulgares vel pretiosi." is set in larger type but treated as a paragraph.
